needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous footway along the left side to provide a safe pedestrian path.
Construct a continuous footway along the right side to provide a safe pedestrian path.
Install a signalised pedestrian crossing to safely allow foot traffic across the street.
Add a pedestrian refuge island in the middle of the street to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing.
Install dropped kerbs at the crossing points to allow wheelchair access and improve safety for pedestrians.
Install street lighting along the road to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians and drivers at night.
